name: Sampling-rate-based lens
definition: A lens that modifies the sampling rate of rays cast towards the object, resulting in varying ray densities (dense in center, coarse at boundary) to achieve different magnification effects without changing ray directions.
summary: The sampling-rate-based lens achieves focus+context magnification by varying ray start positions to create dense central sampling while keeping directions parallel, differing from other lenses that alter ray paths or use feature detection.
